node.title: Re: Unicode constant
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
From [doc://perldata#Identifier-parsing]:

If working under the effect of the use utf8; pragma, the following rules apply: / (?[ ( \p{Word} & \p{XID_Start} ) + [_] ]) (?[ ( \p{Word} & \p{XID_Continue} ) ]) * /x

And looking at the [https://unicode.org/cldr/utility/character.jsp?a=%C2%B2&B1=Show|Unicode Character Properties] of U+00B2 SUPERSCRIPT TWO, it's neither XID_Start nor XID_Continue. Although I'm not an expert on Unicode identifiers, this seems like it explains it.
